portfolio_controls.duplicate_policy: Retire or redirect a return whose novelty fingerprint repeats without removing a named gap.

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Realize centered L2 scores by two-sided quadratic DQM paths, lift additively over iid blocks, and project by conditional expectation.

verified_results: Centering is forced on any quadratic-mean tangent by the exact square-root identity, so the tangent set is contained in the centered L2 space.
Every centered L2 score, bounded or not, is realized two-sided by the normalized squared-linear path; the tail term is controlled by dominated convergence and the normalizer term is O(t^2).
The iid product path has score equal to the coordinate sum with exact norm sqrt(b), so the replication map is sqrt(b) times an isometry.

The pushed path under a normalized parameter-independent kernel is quadratic-mean differentiable with score equal to the conditional expectation of the replicated score, proved for bounded scores by a uniform expansion and in general by Hellinger data processing.
The exact extensive information budget is b times the squared score norm minus the pushed squared norm equals the expected conditional variance, with equality exactly at joint coarse measurability.

The bounded action quotient is Fisher-isometric to the bounded centered subspace of L2_0, which is dense and generally proper, so its Fisher completion is L2_0 while the nonlinear action chart remains L-infinity.
open_gaps: Gauge and nuisance constraints may restrict the realized tangent subspace.
Selected coarse-family closure must be constructed for a non-Gaussian coarse law.
Fisher equality at one parameter is not experiment recovery, so no sufficiency conclusion is available from the budget alone.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: DQM scores + squared-linear two-sided path + iid additive lift + conditional score projection + no exponential-chart assumption

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Use normalized Gaussian block sums and Mehler conditional expectation to diagonalize the extensive score operator in the Hermite basis.
mechanism_families.representation: L2_0 of N(0,1) with normalized probabilists' Hermite polynomials.

mechanism_families.failure_test: Fix mean or variance, change the coarse normalization, leave the Gaussian fixed law, or correlate block variables.
verified_results: For every integer b at least two, the Mehler regression identity gives conditional expectation b^(-k/2) times the Hermite polynomial of the block statistic, uniformly in b and not by induction from the binary case.

The score operator is diagonal in the normalized Hermite basis with eigenvalues b^(1-k/2), is positive self-adjoint and Hilbert-Schmidt with squared-eigenvalue sum b^2/(b-1), and has norm and spectral radius sqrt(b).

The spectrum is the eigenvalue set together with zero; every nonzero value is a simple eigenvalue, the kernel is trivial, and zero lies in the continuous spectrum because the range is dense and proper.

Under the declared replication sum, unit-variance block statistic, fixed Fisher norm, and log block scale, degree one is relevant, degree two marginal, and degree three and higher irrelevant, with the constant mode absent from the normalized tangent.
The relevant branch is inhabited only through the extensive replication factor, since the one-arrow operator is a contraction and the bounded action sector is nonexpansive.

Jointly Gaussian equicorrelated coordinates give eigenvalues b^(1-k/2) times [1+(b-1)rho]^(k/2), the isotropic multivariate case has degree multiplicity binomial(d+k-1,k), and a general GL(d) action changes the reference law.
open_gaps: Multivariate anisotropic and gauge-mixed extensions require separate diagonalization and a transported family of laws and tangent norms.
Nonlinear attraction, basin control, and the fate of the marginal direction are outside the linear tangent theorem.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: Gaussian fixed score law + iid sum statistic + Mehler diagonalization + Hermite completeness + explicit relevant/marginal/irrelevant modes

reconciliation.issue: Earlier Task 10 material stated a positive infimum of the semiconjugacy factor as though it were necessary for complete-flow traversal.
reconciliation.resolution: Task 12 replaces that statement by the exact endpoint criterion: the accumulated image interval is determined by the two limits of sigma_Q, and full traversal holds exactly when they equal the coarse maximal-interval endpoints. For complete real-line flows this is equivalent to divergence of both improper integrals. The arctan witness shows completeness plus positivity is insufficient, while the arsinh witness shows inf a=0 can still give full traversal.

reconciliation.issue: An independent adversarial audit returned FAIL on the Task 9 checkpoint. Four heading calls in 07b_agent_network_rg.tex carried the label on the following line, so TeX took the label control sequence itself as the second mandatory argument, leaving four labels undefined and six Cref sites unresolved. The published label and cross-reference check did not see it because it matched literal source strings instead of LaTeX argument semantics.
reconciliation.resolution: The four constructs were rewritten as single two-argument heading calls. That is the only source change, and reversing the four line joins reproduces the audited digest byte for byte. The string-level check is retired for this obligation and replaced by a heading-arity-aware scanner that requires both mandatory arguments to be brace groups; it reports FAIL before the repair and PASS after, while the string-level scan returns identical numbers in both states. Transcript in evidence/task-9-heading-repair.md. The audit found no mathematical blocker, and no mathematical disposition in this registry or in the adversarial report is changed.

reconciliation.issue: A later post-freeze Task 13/source-only adversarial challenge found that the source asserted distinct smooth right inverses of one extraction map induce different pullback metrics.
reconciliation.resolution: This is not attributed to the historical Task 12 G oracle dispatch. CE-RIGHT-INVERSE-SAME-METRIC refutes the universal: for the normal location Fisher metric, the distinct constant lifts iota_0 and iota_c both pull back to dx^2, while the diagonal lift pulls back to 2dx^2. A follow-up independent source-only semantic audit APPROVED the exact-current repair diff 3632e4f37910983ca5640a271a89705e824c400b3b040173b1627de2e7ab90a3; the original adversary approved only the preliminary core. The repaired boundary says distinct lifts can, but need not, differ, and a pullback construction must declare its lift unless a separate uniqueness, canonicity, or lift-independence theorem is proved.
